r1.exp: 1=B (Burt: 'put it in a special box which I could lock'). 2=C (Collin: 'I was the one who paid for it'). 3=D (Dianne: 'I would run out... straight to the shop'). 4=C (Collin: 'wanted to see a film or something, I was the one who paid'). 5=D (Dianne: 'sweets, chocolates and crisps'). 6=E (Ellen: 'getting the new releases of various bands'). 7=A (Anna Marie: 'I didn't get it very often'). 8=D (Dianne: 'I could hardly wait for my dad to come home on Friday'). 9=B (Burt: 'now I know there is no point in dying rich, and I WISH I HAD SPENT my pocket money on records and games'). 10=E (Ellen: 'that wasn't such a bad thing, because I LEARNED THE VALUE OF MONEY and even today I'm careful how I spend it'). 11=F (Frederick: 'I didn't want to appear different from the others, or have the role of the rich kid'). 12=A (Anna Marie: 'I used to immediately put it somewhere where my sisters couldn't find it').

r13.exp: 'What AMAZED me was how, despite its size, it looked so ELEGANT as it swam by' = ljepota pokreta = A.

r14.exp: 'I KNEW, THERE AND THEN, WHAT I WANTED TO DO WITH MY LIFE' = odredilo mu karijeru = D.

r15.exp: 'What we really rely on is input from the GENERAL PUBLIC... without VOLUNTEERS we wouldn't function' = obični građani = C.

r16.exp: 'Nothing can beat being in a BOAT RIGHT NEXT TO A WHALE' — najdraži je fizički kontakt = D. (Zaštita je važna ali 'most enjoys' = biti uz kita.)

r17.exp: 'What ATTRACTS me is that there is STILL SO MUCH ABOUT THEM THAT WE DON'T KNOW' = još puno za otkriti = A.

r18.exp: 'Would like to say confident, but the reality is... some recovering, others not' = nesiguran, dvosmislen pogled = B (Uncertain).

r19.exp: 'Have to find them. (19)___. First planet only discovered in 1995.' → E: But this will take some time to do. Proces traženja je spor.

r20.exp: 'Emptier vacuum. (20)___. This is Proxima Centauri, 4.3 light years away.' → A: And there is a lot of this nothingness until you get to the next bit of something.

r21.exp: 'Should be MILLIONS of civilizations. (21)___. The trouble is, the average distance would be 200 light years.' → D: This is quite an impressive number. Kontrast: impresivan broj, ali daleko od sebe.

r22.exp: 'Aliens watching our world through telescope. (22)___. They're watching the 19th century.' → G: They can't see you and me. Svjetlost s 19. st. tek stiže, ne mogu nas još vidjeti.

r23.exp: 'Fastest speed ever. (23)___. Took 12 years to cross Pluto's orbit.' → C: However, it's rather slow on a cosmic scale.

r24.exp: 'What are the chances of appearing at the same time? (24)___. Aliens may have appeared hundreds of millions of years before us.' → F: They seem very, very small. Šanse su miniaturne.

r25.exp: 'The site was CHOSEN in 1790 by George Washington' — 'chosen' (izabrano/odabrano mjesto). 'Elected' = izabran za položaj, ne za lokaciju.

r26.exp: 'Considerable effort in construction. NEVERTHELESS, he was the only President not to live in it.' — 'nevertheless' za kontrast (trud, ali ipak nije u njemu živio).

r27.exp: 'Construction was NEARLY completed' — 'nearly' = skoro, gotovo (adverb uz pridjeve/participe).

r28.exp: 'Rebuilt according to the ORIGINAL plans' — fiksna kolokacija: original plans = prvotni, izvorni planovi.

r29.exp: 'Most important EXPANSION was the construction of the East Wing' — 'expansion' = proširenje (fizičko proširenje zgrade).

r30.exp: 'The West Wing, which CONTAINS the famous Oval Office' — 'contain' = sadržavati, imati u sebi (za zgrade/prostore).

r31.exp: 'Wasn't called the White House AT the beginning' — fiksni izraz: at the beginning = na početku.

r32.exp: 'Gave it ITS present name' — posvojna zamjenica 'its' (gave the building its name = dati zgradi njezino ime).

r33.exp: 'The richest source IN the world' — prijedlog 'in' uz superlativne konstrukcije (the richest in the world).

r34.exp: 'By no MEANS all fiction' — fiksni izraz: by no means = nikako, nipošto.

r35.exp: 'What ABOUT London's Ha-Ha Road?' — fiksni izraz: what about = a što kažeš za, a kako je s.

r36.exp: 'The people WHOSE enviable job it is' — posvojni relativni prilog 'whose' (people + their job = whose job).

r37.exp: 'Road names HAVE traditionally been used' — present perfect uz 'traditionally' (dugogodišnja tradicija).

r38.exp: 'What ARE we to think of...' — konstrukcija: be to + infinitive = što nam je reći/misliti (u retorskom pitanju).

r39.exp: 'Instead of MAKING our streets sound cosy' — 'instead of' + gerund; make + object + adjective = učiniti nešto zvučati...

r40.exp: 'Keep strangers AWAY from our homes' — frazalni glagol: keep away (from) = držati podalje od.

sol.rubric: Esej 200-250 riječi. ZA (smartfoni = manje razmišljamo): ovisnost, autocorrect smanjuje pismenost, GPS zamjenjuje orijentaciju, Google zamjenjuje pamćenje. PROTIV: vježbamo um aplikacijama, dostupnost znanja, kreativnost, komunikacija. Vlastito mišljenje.

w1.exp: Esej — ručno se ocjenjuje. Diskusijski esej (for and against + opinion). Viša razina: akademski stil, 200–250 riječi.
